just_in.title: Flash Floods Rip Apart Bridge in Uttarakhand's Niti Valley, BRO Driver Missing
just_in.excerpt: A violent flash flood in Chamoli district swept away a bridge and a vehicle on the Jyotirmath-Malari highway, cutting off over a dozen border villages as monsoon fury continues across the state.

just_in.excerpt: India now has 52 universities in the QS World Rankings, up from 11 a decade ago, with IIT Delhi achieving the highest position ever for an Indian institution.

just_in.title: Indian-Origin Teenagers Shreyas Royal and Bodhana Sivanandan Win 2026 British Chess Championships
just_in.excerpt: Shreyas Royal, 17, becomes the youngest British Chess Champion in history while 11-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan claims the Women's title at the record-breaking Coventry event.
just_in.image_caption: Shreyas Royal, 17, became the youngest British Chess Champion in the tournament's 122-year history at Coventry. Bodhana Sivanandan, 11, won the Women's title after a rapid playoff.
just_in.nri_angle: Both champions have Indian-origin families — Royal's parents emigrated from India and nearly faced deportation in 2018, while Sivanandan's parents moved from Tamil Nadu to London in 2007.

just_in.title: DOL Prevailing Wage Rule Could Price Out Smaller Employers and Immigrants
just_in.excerpt: A proposed rule raising H-1B and PERM wage floors by roughly $14,000 per worker per year threatens to shut smaller employers and nonprofits out of the immigration system.
just_in.image_caption: The U.S. Department of Labor building in Washington, D.C. The department's proposed prevailing wage rule would raise salary floors for H-1B, PERM, and related visa programs by roughly $14,000 per worker per year.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian H-1B workers, the largest visa holder group, face higher wage thresholds that could reduce sponsorship opportunities at smaller firms while strengthening protections for those already employed.

nri-world.image_caption: Toronto Police had issued a Canada-wide warrant for Abdul Ghafoori after Himanshi Khurana was found dead in December 2025. Ghafoori has now been arrested approximately seven months later.
nri-world.nri_angle: The murder and subsequent manhunt highlighted safety concerns for Indian nationals in Canada and prompted diplomatic intervention from the Indian Consulate General in Toronto.

nri-world.excerpt: The IISER Pune professor becomes the first Indian-born scientist to receive the ICTP Dirac Medal, awarded alongside three co-laureates for pioneering work in statistical mechanics and AI.

nri-world.excerpt: Varsha Gohil's two-decade fight against a husband who concealed £28 million has changed UK divorce law for women married to men who hide their wealth.
